author: Warner Bros.
description:
Michael B. Jordan delivers a remarkable dual performance as "Smoke" and "Stack" in SINNERS, brought to life and made visually seamless on screen by the Visual Effects team. Using the innovative "halo rig", technical dollies, and advanced VFX techniques to merge shots, the team captured full-body twin sequences, cigarette passes, and intricate fight choreography, allowing both characters to interact naturally. Every movement, interaction, and reaction - including the subtle distinction of dimples appearing for one twin but not the other using specific facial muscles—remains entirely Michael’s, highlighting his dual performance while VFX heightens the realism and dramatic impact of the twins. 

Now nominated for a record-breaking 16 Academy Awards including Best Visual Effects.
title: TWINNING with the SINNERS Visual Effects Team | Warner Bros. Entertainment

author: Warner Bros.
description:
Paul Thomas Anderson's ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER is driven by a script of rare precision and intention. As Colonel Lockjaw is interrogated by Virgil Throckmorton in order to join the "Christmas Adventurers Club,” the scene is a testament to the film's narrative ambition, blending thematic complexity with character-driven intensity. Anderson crafts a confrontation where ideology and identity collide, revealing emotional undercurrents beneath the formal structure of interrogation. Sean Penn approaches the role of Lockjaw with disciplined subtlety, revealing vulnerability beneath authority and layering his gravitas with internal tension. 

Now nominated for 13 Academy Awards including Best Picture, Best Adapted Screenplay, and Actor in a Supporting Role.
title: Script To Screen: Christmas Adventurers Club | ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER #shorts

author: Warner Bros.
description: In ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER, an ominous, tightly controlled score from Composer Jonny Greenwood defines the confrontation between "Colonel Steven J. Lockjaw" and "Willa" from its opening beat. As the score intensifies and "masterfully tracks the laughs and builds suspense," the result is a sequence where sound and performance operate in seamless tension that reinforces the film’s meditation on authority and consequence. Now nominated for 13 Academy Awards including Best Original Score.
title: Script to Screen: Aunt Gladys Bowl of Water | Amy Madigan | WEAPONS #shorts
